hero.title: Discover the Bread of Life
hero.subtitle: At 'Bread of Life', we want to walk with you. In this space you will find articles, resources, and links that will help you know God.

about.title: Who We Are
description: We are a community of people who wish to share with everyone what God has done in us. We have experienced the forgiveness of our sins, peace with God, the true meaning of life, His love, and a real transformation in our hearts.

All this is something great that we cannot stop sharing. Each person carries a void inside and tries to fill it in many ways, but only God can truly fill it. It is not about religion, rules, or rituals, but about a living and authentic relationship with our great God and Creator.
At 'Bread of Life', we want to walk with you. Through this space, you will find articles, resources, and links that will help you know God and experience His forgiveness and love.

If you have questions about God, are looking for hope, or wish to learn more about 'the way, the truth, and the life', this is your place. Here you will find a safe, respectful, and loving environment. We are a community committed to loving God and loving people, regardless of their background, history, or situation.

evangelistic.title: Who is Jesus?
evangelistic.description: Jesus is more than a historical figure. He is the Bread of Life, the Light of the World, and the Prince of Peace. His life, death, and resurrection offer us a path to reconciliation with God. We invite you to discover His love and truth.

videos.title: Discover More
videos.description: Explore our library of videos that uncover the history of God's promises and the life of the Messiah.

items.title: Jesus film
items.description: Although no actor is worthy of portraying the life of Jesus, this film was made in order to help us learn about the story of the life of Jesus Christ while He was here on earth. The film is based on the narrative of the Gospel of Luke. We encourage you to watch it; in the introduction you will discover why it was so necessary for Jesus to come.

items.title: Watch the King of Glory Movie
items.description: This movie takes you on a captivating 15-episode chronological journey through the ancient Scriptures of the prophets, presenting their story and message in a clear and understandable way.

items.title: The Story of the Bible
items.description: This video summarizes the overall story of the Bible as a series of crossroad decisions. All humanity, followed by the Israelites, redefine good and evil and end up in Babylon. They are followed by Jesus, who takes a different path that opens up the way to a new creation.

items.title: What is the Bible?
items.description: Learn about the Bible and how to read it well: from an introduction to the important differences of the various literary genres compiled within.

spiritualJourney.title: The Good News
questions: Do you feel an emptiness in your life even though you seek to please God?
Are you troubled by your sense of sins and wrongdoings?
Do you fear what lies beyond death?
message: Jesus Christ said: If you abide in my word, you are truly my disciples, and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
The inner peace you need comes only when you have a right relationship with God. God does not expect you to be the most religious, or to do many things for Him.

The holy God loves us and wants us to have a relationship with Him. He cleanses us from our sins and grants us freedom. God wants you to enjoy His company, because the emptiness you feel is caused by the absence of God in your life.
We cannot erase our sins by our own efforts, no matter how hard we try. That is why God, who loved us, gave us a Savior and created the way through which we can come to Him.
Do you want to know Him? Jesus Christ said: I am the way, the truth, and the life.
spiritualJourney.prayer: O Lord, Creator of the heavens and the earth, I ask You to save me, guide me to the truth, and lead me to the path that brings me to You. Amen.

contact.title: We'd Love to Hear From You
contact.description: Do you have questions? Do you need prayer or someone to talk to? Our team is here for you. Reach out to us via email, WhatsApp, or phone.

form.successMessage: Thank you for reaching out. We will get back to you soon.
form.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

bibleReading.title: Read or listen to the Bible online
bibleReading.description: The Word of God is living and powerful; experience it for yourself! Enjoy reading it and let God speak to you through it.

yourStory.title: Your Story
yourStory.description: This small booklet offers you an overview of the Bible and shows how your own story can be forever connected to the story of your Creator. In its 36 pages, it summarizes the greatest story and the greatest message ever told.
